code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild hypoglycemia. There are also elevated basophils and monocytes, and low neutrophil percentage. Mild metabolic acidosis is suggested by low total CO₂. Liver and kidney function tests are within normal limits. Findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or systemic illness; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
